method: Injected virtual clock/scheduler exercise the production recorder module without waiting 120 real seconds. Native browser timing is checked separately.

checks.name: initial idle/empty and empty replay rejected
start recording and invalid transitions rejected
FIFO A-S-A with relative millisecond timestamps
stop retains take and cancels the recording timer
snapshot mutation cannot change internal queue
replay starts and guards mutation/re-entry
initial recorded silence is retained
no early second hit
replay preserves exact offsets/order and does not self-record
cancel token blocks old replay callbacks after a new session
clear resets tape in idle
equal timestamps retain FIFO insertion order
255 hits still recording
256th hit retained, automatic stop and overflow rejected
recording remains open before 120 seconds
120-second timer stops and retains queue
late input at duration bound is rejected even if timer was delayed
invalid keys, nonfinite and backwards timestamps are ignored
new recording clears prior take and resets time origin
30 rapid sessions leave no stale timers/hits
scheduler overhead does not accumulate drift
throwing replay adapter returns to idle and retains take
